payload.title: Review Brief: Capability Lifecycle Reporting
payload.summary: Codex PR #5 has been merged into main. I reviewed the actual changed files and implementation. The delivery satisfies the requested capability registry validation and lifecycle reporting package at the implementation level.
implementation_summary: Added src/estate/core/capability_lifecycle.py as the lifecycle validation and reporting module.
Registered capability-lifecycle CLI command in src/estate/cli/main.py with --json support.
ca3_findings: The implementation explicitly states it validates existing registry entries and does not define new maturity states or governance meaning.
The validator uses only the Estate lifecycle states: Designed, Implemented, Operationally Validated, Institutionalized.
It checks capability identifiers, titles, lifecycle state validity, owners, implementation references, evidence references, operational evidence, and institutional references where applicable.
It produces candidates for missing lifecycle state, invalid lifecycle state, implemented-but-missing-evidence, operational validation review, and institutionalization review.
Malformed registry JSON is reported as a warning and does not crash the report.

Tests cover valid entries, missing lifecycle state, invalid lifecycle state, implemented without evidence, Operationally Validated without operational evidence, malformed registry JSON, Markdown generation, and CLI registration/output generation.
lifecycle_assessment: Capability Lifecycle Reporting should be treated as Implemented.
Operational validation remains pending until the command is run against the live Estate repository state after pull and the output is reviewed for usefulness by CA2/CA3/Steward.
This report should remain an operational aid, not a governance source of truth.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm whether this implementation satisfies WP-0006 scope.
Review candidate-generation rules for Operational Validation and Institutionalization review to ensure they do not imply automatic promotion.
Determine whether the generated operations/capabilities/lifecycle_status.md path is acceptable as an operational artifact.
Confirm whether capability registries should now be updated to include lifecycle_state and evidence fields for existing CAP entries, or whether that should remain a separate work package.
recommended_next_validation: Review warnings, especially missing lifecycle_state warnings for existing capabilities.
Decide whether the capability remains Implemented or can advance toward Operationally Validated after real-use review.
